ambient_events: The windsock jerks upright on a gust, points a limp finger down the strip, then dies again.
Grit ticks off the corrugated hangar wall in a long dry hiss.
Far off, an engine drones — climbs, fades, and is gone. Nobody at Buzzard Field looks up.
Heat-shimmer crawls up off the packed-dust runway and wobbles the scrub at the far end.
A loose sheet of roofing metal bangs somewhere behind the hangar, over and over, in a wind that never fully quits.
Chained-down flyers creak against their tie-downs, straining at the wind like dogs on a short lead.
The oil-drum by the apron door still smells of last night's fire; a thread of ash lifts and scatters.
description: A patched-steel hangar squats at the head of a cracked scrub airstrip — in the Reach the only road is the sky, and this is where it touches down. The windsock hangs dead-still over a hand-lettered board: NO MANIFESTS. NO QUESTIONS. CASH ON THE SKID.
name: Buzzard Field
